notes: REWRITE of draft #33: written fresh; none of the old draft's percentages (15-20% ID restriction, 5-8% ovaling, 'nearly 100%', 2-3x cycle time) are reused. No flow-loss percentage is given anywhere because none could be sourced; the article says so plainly. Direct page fetches were blocked (DNS) in this environment, so ALL facts come from web-search result summaries, not pages read directly: The Fabricator (ram bending CLR 3-4x OD 'generally achievable'; rotary draw most versatile; ball mandrel/wiper; charts based on mild steel to 180 deg), Rogue Fab exhaust page (ram benders standard in muffler shops, flatten pipe and wrinkle inside; 0.9% deformation on a 2.75in 1D mandrel bend, from page title/image alt) and Rogue Fab mandrels page (5.5-11% deformation without mandrel vs ~1.8-2.5% with; wall ratio >30 and tighter than 2.5D 'not likely possible'). Please re-verify those Rogue Fab figures on the live pages before publishing; they are presented as vendor figures. The 1D-1.5D 'common in aftermarket exhaust' statement comes from the fact-check notes (Vibrant 1D page + retailer 1.5D listings). Stainless Bros listing for B0778RQTGW says elbows are 'individually extruded' with laser-cut ends; the article mentions this. Khaos B07L72RHHF listing does not state a CLR; article tells readers to check. Wall factor 38.5 = 2.5/.065 (computed). CB1100 forum thread is only used for the general cut-section description (round vs oval), not for numbers.
